'''Garlic''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons, the bulb is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]], and the seeds when cooked.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] garlic plants for their ''cloves''.


[[File:GarlicBasket.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''cloves''.]]
